_about: THE MODULE REGISTRY (user 2026-08-17): the grouping layer over test cases. Every suite in tests.json carries a `modules` array of ids from here; a test tagging ONE module is unit-ish, a test tagging several is end-to-end and is drawn as a riser/pipe connecting the layers it touches. Visual analogy is a BUILDING, not a body (user dropped the body metaphor 2026-08-17): layer order is vertical position in the system diagram — what the player sees at the top, Hedera as the foundation. This file is deliberately data: editing the taxonomy must never require touching a renderer. Environment is NOT a module — it is an attribute of a run (each environment's QA folder is self-scoped; an external tool may later merge environments).

modules.name: Board UI
modules.notes: what the player sees and touches — chips, wheel, motion, layout, settings. The facade of the building.

modules.name: Signing widget (kpool)
modules.notes: the separate kpool_widget — signing modal, sig collection, tx socket, verdict presentation

modules.name: WalletConnect / kWC
modules.notes: pairing, sessions, network scoping — where the app touches an external wallet

modules.name: State sync
modules.notes: game-state broadcast/delta protocol, chat/action streams, reconnection

modules.name: Backend Node.js
modules.notes: hapi game engine + kpool signing pipeline: locks, phases, submission, receipts

modules.name: Asset enrich
modules.notes: token metadata ingestion — two cache paths (signing vs display), xproof, Kache

modules.name: Hedera JS SDK
modules.notes: dependency: tx building/freezing/decoding, node selection — our usage of it, not the SDK itself

modules.name: Hedera network
modules.notes: the foundation: consensus, mirror nodes, ingest windows, real fees and balances

modules.name: Build / release
modules.notes: bundle build, feature-strip purity, deploy integrity — scaffolding, not the building itself

modules.name: Demo economy (kbot)
modules.notes: public demo bots + their float accounts (Goodwin etc.) — narrated value must match chain truth
